# FlowForm

> The open-source, dual-licensed form and workflow engine for developers.

FlowForm provides two primary operational modes:
- **Mode 1 (Headless Form Endpoint):** Simple zero-JS HTML contact form backend for static sites (Astro, Next.js, Hugo, HTML). Drop-in alternative to Web3Forms and Formspree with built-in honeypot spam protection, instant email forwarding, and clean JSON payload storage. Endpoint: `POST https://demo.flowformhq.com/f/{slug}` or `POST https://demo.flowformhq.com/api/v1/f/{slug}`.
- **Mode 2 (Dynamic Multi-Step Wizard Engine):** Schema-driven multi-step forms with conditional logic jumps, step sequencing, and server-side validation. Alternative to Typeform and Tally. Drop-in starter kits for React, Vue 3, Next.js, and Livewire.
